messages:
Maria: Heads up - Nimbus Health wants a POC this week. Need a tight provisioning + access checklist to hand to their infra lead.
Ash: I put together a concise run-through. We should offer Hosted first, with Dedicated or Private as escalation.
Maria: They need a demo + security answers by Friday. Can we hit that?
Ash: Yes if we lock creds and network today. Key blockers: CIDR overlap checks, KMS access for Private, and sales sign-off on Dedicated pricing.
Maria: Paste the minimal Hosted flow please.
Ash: Hosted POC minimal steps:
- Create demo API key scoped to project (14d expiry).
- Set usage cap: 100k tokens/day and rate limits to protect quotas.
- Create demo model route using a smaller open model to limit cost.
- Provide curl + SDK example and a short test script.

curl sample:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"test"}'
```

Ash: Dedicated notes:
- Need signed MOU for reserved capacity.
- Suggest 2x A10-equivalent boxes for demo with autoscale base 1 -> burst 4.
- Billing PO and contact required before provisioning.

Ash: Private/VPC quick checklist:
- Customer to propose VPC peering or PrivateLink endpoint + egress rules.
- Provide CIDR ranges; we require non-overlap or route adjustments.
- Cross-account service role + service account for provisioning.
- KMS key ARN with decrypt perms; confirm HSM if requested.
- Audit log retention and who owns logs.

Maria: Kevin any security flags?
Kevin: Ask Nimbus about data classification. If PHI, we need DPA addendum and tighter KMS controls. Also confirm where access to key material will be held and whether they need HSM-backed KMS.

Maria: Jamal can you spin Dedicated quickly if they sign?
Jamal: Yes - once billing is cleared ~6 hours to provision. Private needs their network details and a ticket; we can usually do same-day with complete info.

Liz: Ill assemble the handoff doc and send the security questionnaire. Will include hosted key example and the minimal checklist.

Maria: OpsBot create a provisioning ticket.
OpsBot: Ticket created POC-3198 assigned to @Jamal priority: high. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-3198

Jamal: Added note on ticket: need customer CIDR, preferred key rotation window, and billing PO.

Maria: Pricing ask from Nimbus: estimate for ~2k concurrent demo users for 2 hours. Quick calc?
Ash: Very rough: Hosted w/ gpt-mini ~0.5M tokens -> $40-80 depending on tier. Dedicated reserved box for demo window ~$200-350/hr. Note: big variance for long context or multi-turn sessions.

Kevin: If they opt for Private, loop in Legal early for DPA and any compliance clauses. Ill start a draft.

Liz: Sending questionnaire to Nimbus now and cc-ing Kevin + Jamal. Ill update the ticket when they reply.

Maria: Great. One ops tip: enable prefix/KV caching on the demo route to reduce token usage for repeat prompts.
Jamal: Will enable caching on the sandbox route before handoff.

Maria: Thanks team. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
